all_completion_and_external_effects_reso.mechanism: every advance-or-refuse decision resolves to one immutable receipt that is a pure function of its inputs: there is no clock and no random draw, the caller supplies created_at, and the gate id and receipt hash re-derive byte for byte from the receipt's own published fields, so replaying a call reproduces the receipt

governing_schemas_authority_boundaries_f.mechanism: the out-of-distribution challenge class is read from the challenge-genome schema and the passing cascade status from the promotion-decision schema's own hard-gate vocabulary; the candidate-generating roles come from the verifier firewall; each composed artifact is validated against its canonical schema; and every FINDING_CODE names an exact refusal

happy_negative_crash_resume_adversarial_.mechanism: the happy path advances and replays deterministically; each of a failed or incomplete cascade, an unadmitted or tampered admissibility receipt, an absent, refuted or unresolved OOD challenge, a replication ceiling below the configured level, and a candidate-generating requester is refused; crash/resume maps to replay determinism for this pure module

no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: nothing here scores, selects, promotes or evaluates; a candidate-generating requesting role is refused with the set the verifier firewall declares, promotion authority lives in governance.promotion and takes no score, and this gate holds none of it

gate_semantics.produces: advance-or-refuse receipt; no score, selection or promotion

independent_review.evidence: review.md (author: bounded implementation agent; reviewer: the primary sealing session; actor_independence between author and reviewer holds, external certification does not; verdict PASS, blocking_finding_count=0)
